name: Tombstone
summary: Rounded grey headstone with a crack and grass tufts, marked RIP or left blank; for graveyard and Halloween scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: the base of the stone rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 330 px wide and 480 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.6 next to a person

params.name: inscription
params.note: RIP = a bold RIP carved in the stone; blank = no lettering

author: krakujs
